description: Test vectors for participant_recovery_ack_sign(hostseckey, recovery_data, params, aux_rand).
Creates a participant's acknowledgment signature on the transcript contained in the
recovery data.
A test case may provide 'params', 'recoveryData', and/or 'auxRand' fields to override
the group-level values.
For each valid test case:
Call participant_recovery_ack_sign(hostseckey, recoveryData, params, auxRand).
Verify the returned acknowledgment signature equals expectedAckSig.
For each error test case:
Call participant_recovery_ack_sign(hostseckey, recoveryData, params, auxRand).
Verify it raises an exception matching expectedError.
Error objects contain 'type' (exception class name) and optionally:
- 'message': human-readable description (informational, not required to match exactly)
For each input validation error test case:
Proceed as for error test cases. These test cases pass a fixed-size argument of
wrong length (e.g., a host secret key that is not 32 bytes or a signature in pmsgs2
that is not 64 bytes), for which the reference implementation raises ValueError.
Implementations whose types rule out such arguments (e.g., fixed-size byte arrays)
may skip them. Wrong lengths that depend on t or n (e.g., of cmsg1 or pmsgs1) are
covered by the error test cases (LengthDoesNotMatchParamsError).
